verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms a generous free tier exists and is usable for meaningful prototyping (e.g. 300k embeddings only 10% of free-tier limit), and other developers describe onboarding as smooth/'just works', though one comment notes signups were sometimes closed due to demand. Missing for 10: first-party docs pack contains no pricing page or explicit free-tier terms/limits, and there's no recent independent confirmation of current free-tier generosity or signup availability.
